```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Setup
# ==============================
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = "~/R")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

# Core libraries
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(readxl)
  library(janitor)
  library(lubridate)
  library(knitr)
  library(kableExtra)
})

# Cohort sizes
TOTAL_N    <- 310
SCREENED_N <- 108
```

```{r load_data, include=FALSE}
# ==============================
# Load and clean data
# ==============================
file_path <- "Natera_Sheet_cleaned.xlsx"
dat <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = 1, col_names = TRUE) %>%
  clean_names() %>%
  mutate(patient_id = record_id_linking_key) %>%
  filter(!is.na(patient_id)) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ifelse(. == "", NA, .)))
```

```{r data_summary}
# ==============================
# Data Summary
# ==============================
cat("## ctDNA Analysis Summary\n\n")
cat("**Cohort Information:**\n")
cat("- Target cohort size:", TOTAL_N, "patients\n")
cat("- Currently screened:", SCREENED_N, "patients\n")
cat("- Screening completion:", round(SCREENED_N/TOTAL_N*100, 1), "%\n\n")

cat("**Data Overview:**\n")
cat("- Total patient records:", nrow(dat), "\n")
cat("- Records with valid IDs:", sum(!is.na(dat$patient_id)), "\n\n")

# Count ctDNA columns
ctdna_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), "^ct_dna_level_\\d+$") & !str_detect(names(dat), "_date$")]
ctdna_date_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), "^ct_dna_level_\\d+_date$")]

cat("**ctDNA Data:**\n")
cat("- ctDNA value columns:", length(ctdna_cols), "\n")
cat("- ctDNA date columns:", length(ctdna_date_cols), "\n\n")
```

```{r ctDNA_analysis}
# ==============================
# ctDNA Analysis
# ==============================
cat("## ctDNA Test Results\n\n")

# Count patients with ctDNA data
patients_with_ctdna <- dat %>%
  select(patient_id, all_of(ctdna_cols)) %>%
  mutate(has_ctdna = rowSums(!is.na(select(., -patient_id))) > 0) %>%
  filter(has_ctdna) %>%
  nrow()

cat("**Patients with ctDNA data:**", patients_with_ctdna, "\n\n")

# Count total ctDNA tests
total_ctdna_tests <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(ctdna_cols)) %>%
  summarise(total_tests = sum(!is.na(.))) %>%
  pull(total_tests)

cat("**Total ctDNA tests:**", total_ctdna_tests, "\n\n")

# Summary by ctDNA level
ctdna_summary <- dat %>%
  select(all_of(ctdna_cols)) %>%
  summarise_all(~sum(!is.na(.))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "ctdna_level", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(level_num = as.numeric(str_extract(ctdna_level, "\\d+"))) %>%
  arrange(level_num) %>%
  filter(count > 0)

cat("**ctDNA Tests by Level:**\n")
print(ctdna_summary)
```

```{r demographics}
# ==============================
# Demographics
# ==============================
cat("## Patient Demographics\n\n")

# Race distribution
if ("race" %in% names(dat)) {
  race_table <- table(dat$race, useNA = "no")
  cat("**Race Distribution:**\n")
  print(race_table)
  cat("\n")
}

# Ethnicity distribution
if ("ethnicity" %in% names(dat)) {
  ethnicity_table <- table(dat$ethnicity, useNA = "no")
  cat("**Ethnicity Distribution:**\n")
  print(ethnicity_table)
  cat("\n")
}

# Cancer stage
if ("cancer_stage_natera" %in% names(dat)) {
  stage_table <- table(dat$cancer_stage_natera, useNA = "no")
  cat("**Cancer Stage Distribution:**\n")
  print(stage_table)
  cat("\n")
}
```

```{r systemic_therapy_summary}
# ==============================
# Systemic Therapy Summary
# ==============================
cat("## Systemic Therapy\n\n")

# NAC summary
if ("neoadjuvant_systemic_therapy_yes_no" %in% names(dat)) {
  nac_table <- table(dat$neoadjuvant_systemic_therapy_yes_no, useNA = "no")
  cat("**Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy:**\n")
  print(nac_table)
  cat("\n")
}

# Systemic therapy columns
systemic_cols <- names(dat)[str_detect(names(dat), "^systemic_therapy_\\d+$")]
if (length(systemic_cols) > 0) {
  cat("**Systemic Therapy Regimens:**\n")
  systemic_summary <- dat %>%
    select(all_of(systemic_cols)) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "therapy", values_to = "regimen") %>%
    filter(!is.na(regimen)) %>%
    count(regimen, sort = TRUE)
  
  print(systemic_summary)
}
```
